book.name: Iluk
book.title: Weng Kal Ken Ati Iluk ete Bose te.

content: Beli, Sunbin-Finik em kitil e Yesus em ibolow tem dewkitil molei, e uneko, Yoldan bang dikeko, kawtiw banim dim kalo unse kale.
Unei, akalkafo akalkafo ding e 40 kel kelei, Seten-Ataanim e Yesus elo kiskis kolewse kale. Beem ding dim bakate, Yesus e wanin waninba keko, yemen tewso alenale kale.
Bomelei, Seten-Ataanim e bokolewomele: “Ku Sunbin-Got em Min kasike, tum kaleelo ‘Wanin kela!’, dangeko, wanolewka!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Yesus e yan weng bokolewomele: “Sunbin-Got em fut ayem tem kel weng mak bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Kunum waneng im sunsun finik so biliw ibolow fukunin e wanin emisik atew bate!’,

content: angbe kate.”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Seten-Ataanim e elo amgu tikin dim moko, fongate akate kunum mongom angom alik alik im aneng aneng be kukulewse kale.

Kukuleweko, bokolewomele: “Kunum waneng biim aneng aneng kale so ikalem on kisol so eisneng so alik alik be nakalem ete kuw kasike, ne nakalem ibolow kuw geleweko, mali ilo duyemoki te. Kame, ku kilila! Alik alik mesesem eisneng be ne kulo dukemoki te.
Dukemoki kate kame, nem wiin daonemoleka!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Yesus e yan weng bokolewomele: “Sunbin-Got em fut ayem tem e bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Yu Kamok Fian Sunbin-Got em wiin ete kuw daoko,

content: angbe kate.”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Seten-Ataanim e Yesus elo Selusalem abiw mutuk fian elo debeleko, Sunbin-Got em am yol em am gong dim moko, bokolewomele: “Ku Sunbin-Got em Min kasike kame, ku yol miteko, una!
Nimtew angom? Sunbin-Got em fut ayem tem be bokolomele:
angeko, iti weng mak bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Teing dim da kokemiwi, yol mit telew tewe,

content: angbe te.”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Yesus e iti yan weng bokolewomele: “Sunbin-Got em fut tem akal bokolomele:

content.text: ‘Yu kanelom yom Kamok fian Sunbin-Got elo sak kuw kak kelewokoliw te!’,

content: angbe kate!”, dangse kale.
Dangei, Seten-Ataanim e kak kelewbe be kolewsomi, Yesus em be dim be koleweko, uneko, “Yesus elo iti kak keloki deiw mak fenbi te!”, angse kale.
Nasalet Abiw Ka kel Alenale em Sang te.

Beli, Sunbin-Finik em kitil e Yesus em ibolow tem iti dawkitil molei, e Galili aneng fian elo unse kale. Unei, aneng kasel alik i kililiwete: “Yesus e teleko, Galili aneng fian ka kel be kai!”, ange ange kesiliw kale.
Keko beli, Yesus e kawtiw im wensankakbiliw am dim kalo uneko, bokoyem yak bokoyem yak kesomi, Sunbin-Got em weng bakayemale kale. Bakayembelei, i kiliko, em wiin fian daosiliw kale.

Deiw mak ding mak kabalak e, e akalem aul gel dim bise Nasalet abiw kalo unse kale. Unei, finengdakamin ding Sabat kese ding dim bakate, e akalem kukuw geleweko, Suda im wensankabiliw am kawtem elo unse kale. Uneko beli, e moko, Sunbin-Got em fut tem weng teing bokolomin ibolow kese kale.
Kelei, i Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin kunum Aisaya em fut tem bose weng be elo dulewsiliw kale. Dulewiwi, e fut be bamtak kelewko, fut dil dim mak fen atemeko, teing bokose kale. E bokolomele:

content.text: “Kamok Fian em Sunbin-Finik e nem dim kel alakabe te.
E nelo akalem wiin so amkose kasike kame, ne uneko, baluw kawtiw ilo weng ken ati be bakayem tem unekabi te.
E nelo namdalei, ne teleko, sok am tem biliw kawtiw ilo sok am tem be kolew tolomin em weng bokoyemeko, kiin sukul kawtiw biilo kiin golomin weng bakayembi te.
Beemdiw, e nelo namdalei, ne wiin de mit dakayemsomi, ilum so biliw kawtiw ilo ilum beelo kilele keemomin telesomi,
Kamok Fian em kiin dim e itol ken ati mak em weng kal bakayem teli te.”, angse kale.

content: Angeko, fut be iti net kelewko, fut duku atebiliw kunum ilo duyemeko, teinse kale. Teinei, ka kel wensankabiliw kunum waneng i Yesus elo kiin sen so kelewsiliw kale.
Kelewiwi, e ilo bokoyemomele: “Kame kuw, fut kaleem weng mongom e fein kaim dim fitewkabe te.”, yangse kale.

Yangei, kunum waneng alik alik i akalem weng kiliko, yol angeko, em wiin daoko, bokolomeliw: “Ai! Weng ati te ati weng bokolaka! Kate, e Yosew em min ete sako? Weng kiol kuw, weng ati bokole kasike!”, ange ange kesiliw kale.

Kesomeliwi, e ilo bokoyemomele: “Yu kiskiw weng mak memen keko, bokonemomeliw: ‘Abung gemin kunum kutaka! Kukalem wakamin emisik iti ken kelewbolewka! Kate kame, Kafelneam abiw mutuk fian em kaneselew mesesem mesesem eisneng be kukalem abiw kale kel akati kanelolewka!’, nangbiliw te.
Kate, yu kilele ibolow fukunina! Awkunum kusel i Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin kunum elo nam ‘Fein!’, dangiw te.

Kame, yu nem weng kale kilele kililina! Sua kel akate, Elaisa e kitil weng mak bokose kasike, yemamas kel itol so, gung kel kayow so, ding beem ding dim bakate, aneng am ken am kuw kesomi, suuk banim kese kale. Beem ding dim bakate, Isalael kawtiw im mutuk e kalun waneng demdem mak alenaliw kate,

Elaisa e Isalael waneng kalun mak um mit mewso uninba kese kale. E Saidon abiw mutuk fian em mit mewso uneko, Salefat abiw fong gel elo teleko, Isalael kawtiw num ibik biliw kawtiw im waneng kalun mak um mit mewso unse kale.

Beemdiw, Sunbin-Got em bontem dim bakamin kunum Elisa em ding dim kabalak e, Isalael aneng kale bulul abung fian so kunum waneng demdem ke alenaliw kate, e num ibik biliw kawtiw Silia kayak Naman ete kuw iti okmino kolewse kale.”, yangse kale.

Yangei, wensankabiliw kunum waneng alik bi Yesus em Isalael kawtiw im ibik biliw kawtiw dokoyemsiliw weng alew be kiliko, kaisuw fian kuw kelewsiliw kale. Nimtew angom? I ibolow fukunomeliw: “Sunbin-Got e Isalael kawtiw nukalem ete kuw dokoyemkabe kai!”, ange ange kesiliw kale.
Kesomi, elo aluwko, kut elo debele uneko, abiw beem mewso alenale amgu gen em fes dim kalo fes dalomin unsiliw kale.
Unsiliw kate, e ilo sak koyemeko, ikalem mutuk akate bik unse kale.
Aneng Matil so Kunum em Sang te.

Beli, e Nasalet abiw be koleweko, iti Galili aneng fian em abiw mutuk fian Kafelneam kalo unese kale. Unei, finengdakamin ding Sabat alik alik im ding dim bakate, e kunum waneng ilo Sunbin-Got em weng kukuyemse kale.
Kukuyemei, ka biliw kawtiw i Yesus em kitil so auk so weng be kilisomi, yol angsiliw kale.

Keko beli, em Suda kawtiw im wensankabiliw am dim unse ding dim mak bakate, aneng matil em dim teinbe kunum mak belei, e elo atemse kale. Atemei, aneng matil em dim teinbe kunum be gaanin fian mak gaaneko, bokolewomele:

“Ibo! Ibo! Nasalet abiw em kunum Yesus kutaka! Ku nulo noyemomin talbelew o? Ku nulo wa keyemomin telew sako? Ne kilele kal kelite: Ku Sunbin-Got akalem wiin so galmose kunum ayem kute te!”, dangeko olse kale.

Olei, Yesus e kitil weng mak bokolewomele: “Fongate akate kimi angeko, kunum beelo koleweko, unolewka!”, dangse kale. Dangei, aneng matil bi em yange weng be kiliko, kunum beelo ka biliw kawtiw im mutuk dim kalo kuse keleweko, kawin dim butut koleweko, fein unsiliw kale. Kanesiliw kate, i kunum beelo alinba kesiliw kale.

Keko beli, ka biliw kawtiw alik alik i yol angeko, bokolomeliw: “Kunum beem yangbe weng be nono ye? E aneng matil biilo kitil so auk so weng mak bokoyemei, i fongate akate em yangbe weng be kiliko, em dim teinbiliw kunum beelo koleweko, uniw kasike!”, ange ange kesiliw kale.
Keko beli, kawtiw i em kanese sang be deeko, Galili aneng fian em abiw mak abiw mak alik alik kalo de unsiliw kale.
Kal Wanin Wakamin Kawtiw im Sang te.

Beli, Yesus e Suda im wensan kekabiliw am dim beelo iti koleweko, Saimon em am kalo unse kale. Em unse ding dim bakate, Saimon em kalel um auk u kal mamin wakamin fian so kesomi, abin kon tem akalbu kasike, i Yesus elo kalan atebam talsiliw kale.

Kalan atebam teliwi, e kiliko, um mit mewso uneko, kitil weng mak wakamin wa beelo dangse kale. Dangei, wakamin be waneng buulo fein koumeko, unei, u ken kesomi, baba teineko, wanin wanomin memen keyemeko, fuyemsu kale.
Keko beli, ataan tem dokong une ding dim bakate, ka biliw kawtiw i kal wanin wakamin so kawtiw ilo em mit yemde teliwi, e akalem teing im kal dim dukuyemsomi, ilo okmino koyemse kale.

Koyemsomi, kawtiw im dim teinbiliw aneng matil banso takalase kale. Ilo takalalei, im koyemsiliw ding dim bakate, aneng matil bi gaanomeliw: “Nu kal keluwete: Fein! Ku Sunbin-Got em Min kute te!”, dangsiliw kasike, e kitil weng kuw bokoyemomele: “Ayem! Yu kanelom gaanokoliw te!”, yangei, i em weng kiliko, kimi angeko, weng banim kesomi, unsiliw kale.

Keko beli, aneng daneko, iti kutim danse ding dim bakate, Yesus e abiw be koleweko, kawtiw banim dim mak elo unse kale. Em ka kel bise ding dim bakate, kawtiw mali mak elo fenem teleko, atemeko, em mit mewso teleko, elo net aluwko, bokolewomeliw: “Ku kanelom nulo koyemokolew te!”, dangsiliw kale.

Dangiwi, e ilo yan weng bokoyemomele: “Babo! Sunbin-Got e nelo namdase kasike, ne abiw mak abiw mak elo unesomi, Sunbin-Got em Weng Kal Ken Ati be bakayem tem bakayem tem kakabomi, bokoyemomeli: ‘Sunbin-Got em gawman ding dim e kame mewso talaka!’, yangeko, kakabi te!”, yangse kale.
Yangeko, ilo koyemeko, Suda kawtiw im wensankabiliw am dim alik alik ilo bakayem tem unse kale.
